visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Live action. A young man with black curly hair and a 'B' cap wears a white tank top, holding a brown paper Taco Bell bag. Behind him, a muscular man in a black 'KingsRise' tank top drinks from a red can. They stand in a bright, sunny driveway with a white car. (2) Desert highway travel. View from a moving vehicle shows flat desert plains and distant brown mountains under a clear sky. A group of motorcyclists is visible on the road. (3) Dodger Stadium exterior. The muscular man walks toward 'Gate A' as a large orange Metro bus passes by. Bright daylight. (4) Inside the stadium. High-angle shots show a baseball pitcher throwing and a batter hitting the ball. The camera cuts to the muscular man's face, smiling broadly with teeth showing, then to the dense crowd cheering and waving hands. (5) Gas station. The curly-haired man fuel a white car at a Chevron station. (6) Night scene. Both men stand in a dimly lit residential driveway next to a car, talking to the camera. The lighting is low-key with artificial street lights nearby.
